**To complete this task, you need to run one of these commands with Administrator privileges:**

**Option 1: PowerShell (as Administrator)**
```powershell
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('PATH', 'C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-25.0.1.8-hotspot\bin;C:\windows\system32;C:\windows;C:\windows\System32\Wbem;C:\windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\;C:\windows\System32\OpenSSH\;C:\Program Files\Git\cmd;C:\Program Files\GitHub CLI\;C:\Program Files\nodejs\;/home/author\.sentinel\bin', 'Machine')
```

**Option 2: Command Prompt (as Administrator)** — simpler, just appends to existing PATH
```cmd
setx /M PATH "%PATH%;/home/author\.sentinel\bin"
```

Once you run either command, new login shells will have `claude` available globally without users needing to modify their dotfiles. The change applies system-wide to all users on the machine.
